comments.text:
Create a DeviceSpec struct in integral-core that declaratively describes the INTEGRA-7's capabilities. This replaces hardcoded constants scattered across views and CLI.

CONTENTS:
- Output names: [A, B, C, D, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
- Comp+EQ output names: [PART, A, B, C, D, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
- Chorus output names: [MAIN, REV, MAIN+REV]
- Reverb output names: [A, B, C, D]
- Chorus type names, Reverb type names
- Room types, Room sizes (for surround)
- Part count (16), Comp+EQ unit count (6)
- Tone bank groups (currently in web/src/toneBanks.ts and duplicated in VST tone_selector.rs)
- Tone category names (currently in web/src/categories.ts)

This extends ParamRegistry (which covers individual parameter metadata) with device-level structural data.

AUDIT CONTEXT: routing_page.rs, surround_page.rs, tone_editor.rs, and tone_selector.rs all hardcode device constants that should come from this spec.

title: Core: create DeviceSpec with output names, FX types, room types, part count
